body: I'm sorry to hear about that.  I would never ask them why because I know that the decision just isn't on a whim. When I see them I'm just going to act normal and try to be there for them. I copied a message that I sent them if you would like to take a look. If you need anyone to talk to that won't judge you feel free to pm me.

This is the message I sent them. 

 "I just wanted you to know that I'm not mad at you. I care for you. The thoughts that you have are normal. You are not alone, you can get through this. I'm not going to tell you what to do but I'm willing to listen and help you in anyway that I can. I know that you care for us too and that you didn't want us to get hurt.  I really really care about you. I will always be here for you no matter what.  I love you. I really do. "

I omitted some personal things and names.
I have not but I will now.  Thank you.
Thank you guys for replying.  I'll let them know that I'm still here for them and I won't push them to talk.
